user.title: Dreame SF25 — DreameHome credentials
user.description: Enter your DreameHome app account credentials (the same email and password you use in the Dreame mobile app).

reconfigure.title: Dreame SF25 — reconfigure
reconfigure.description: Sign in again to pick a different composter on this account — for example after a warranty replacement, which gives the new unit a different device id. Leave the password blank to keep the stored one.

select_device.title: Select your SF25
select_device.description: Choose the food composter from your DreameHome device list.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the DreameHome cloud. Check your internet connection.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials. Check your DreameHome email and password.
error.no_devices_found: No devices found on this account.
error.device_not_found: That device is no longer on the account. Go back and sign in again to refresh the list.

abort.no_devices_found: No DreameHome devices found on this account.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The entry now points at the selected composter.
